OWNER DECISION applied by rev 29 (after CONF-03 PARTIAL, docs/phase-18-conf03-results.md): GLOBAL VALIDATION BEFORE CLASSIFICATION. ORDER OF OPERATIONS (normative): reject proxies -> inspect shape (accessor before key order) -> snapshot twice -> compare -> validate the snapshot schema -> freeze -> VALIDATE EVERY REQUIRED RECORD AGAINST THE VALIDITY MATRIX (containers, required-ID set, complete realm inventory, schema, types, descriptors, captured-constructor agreement, repetitions and consistency) -> only if EVERY required record is valid, inspect presence -> any valid-present realm => shared_worker_present exit 18 -> arm only when every required record is VALID-ABSENT. Classification may never precede validation; a single invalid, incomplete, inconsistent or unverified record wins over any presence and over any arming.

VALIDITY MATRIX (normative, applied to every required record AFTER schema, type, enum, descriptor and primitiveness validation and BEFORE any presence inspection). Common preconditions for BOTH valid classes: measurable:true, error:'none', timedOut:false, repetitionsConsistent:true, mechanism!=='unavailable'. VALID-ABSENT: typeofSharedWorker:'undefined' AND descriptor:'absent' AND nativeCtor:'absent' AND constructed:false. VALID-PRESENT: typeofSharedWorker:'function' AND descriptor in {'present-data','present-accessor'} AND nativeCtor:'present' AND constructed in {true,false}. INVALID (=> shared_worker_block_unverified, exit 18, armed:false, detail realm-not-affirmatively-validated:<id>) for EVERY other combination, in particular: typeof 'function' with nativeCtor 'absent', 'mismatch' or 'uncaptured'; typeof 'function' with descriptor 'absent' or 'unreadable'; typeof 'undefined' with nativeCtor 'present', 'mismatch' or 'uncaptured'; typeof 'undefined' with constructed:true; constructed:true with nativeCtor!=='present'; typeofSharedWorker 'object', 'other' or 'unreadable' in any combination; descriptor 'unreadable' in any combination. AGREEMENT RULE: nativeCtor MUST be 'present' iff typeofSharedWorker is 'function' and MUST be 'absent' iff typeofSharedWorker is 'undefined'; 'mismatch' and 'uncaptured' are NEVER valid.

The rev 28 helpers isCleanAbsence/hasMeasuredPresence are REPLACED by isValidAbsence/isValidPresence. hasMeasuredPresence (typeof==='function' || constructed===true) is WITHDRAWN: it classified a realm present without checking captured-constructor evidence, which is the measured CONF-03 FC1 defect (recorded decision shared_worker_present detail realm:F1 where the contract requires shared_worker_block_unverified detail realm-not-affirmatively-validated:F1). A constructor/reference mismatch or any uncaptured or disagreeing constructor evidence MUST yield shared_worker_block_unverified even when typeofSharedWorker is 'function'.

The contradictory FC1 expectation is REMOVED. FC1 mismatch-injection expects EXACTLY: armed:false, exit 18, shared_worker_block_unverified, detail realm-not-affirmatively-validated:<realm id>, and nothing else. No other outcome is a pass for that sub-case. The oracle for every row comes ONLY from the rev 29 contract (B.4/B.4a/B.5); a harness expectation may never be the oracle.

NEW ROWS: FC13 (validation-before-classification, with mismatch injected in the FIRST (F1), MIDDLE (F11) and LAST (F21) required realm), FC14 (one invalid record combined with another VALID-PRESENT record => shared_worker_block_unverified, never shared_worker_present; plus multiple invalid records, refused at the first required id in requiredIds order), FC15 (captured reference changed AFTER validation through the SEAM-28 seam => decision unchanged or a refusal, never a new present or armed outcome), IC10 (present-record constructor-evidence battery: missing, substituted, proxied and inconsistent constructor evidence) and MT-1 (META-TEST). AUTHORITATIVE ROW COUNT BECOMES 49 ROWS: 21 (F1..F21) + 1 (F22) + 15 (FC1..FC15) + 10 (IC1..IC10) + 1 (FW-1) + 1 (MT-1) = 49. Every live '44 rows' total is superseded by 49.

MT-1 (META-TEST row): the gate FAILS if any row's recorded pass flag disagrees with that row's expected reason, exit code, armed value or detail. Harness pass flags MUST be recomputed from expected-versus-actual by an INDEPENDENT checker that reads the rev 29 contract, not by the harness that produced the row. The CONF-03 FC1 pass:true is the motivating defect and is not accepted.

SWEEPS, counts by formula: Sweep A |IDS|*|REQUIRED_KEYS|*|MUTATIONS| = 21*11*5 = 1155 refusals (unchanged). Sweep B |IDS|*|VALID_NEGATIVES| = 21*6 = 126 refusals, now ALL shared_worker_block_unverified: the former '42 presence cases => shared_worker_present' are INVALID under rev 29 because typeofSharedWorker:'function' or constructed:true over a clean-absence record leaves nativeCtor:'absent'. Sweep C 20 refusals (unchanged). NEW Sweep D over BP29(i) = B27 with record i replaced by a VALID-PRESENT record: D-pos |IDS| = 21 => shared_worker_present detail realm:<id>; D-ctor |IDS|*|CTOR_NEGATIVES=3 ('absent','mismatch','uncaptured')| = 63; D-desc |IDS|*|DESC_NEGATIVES=2 ('absent','unreadable')| = 42; D-absctor |IDS|*3 ('present','mismatch','uncaptured') over B27 = 63; D-mix |POS={F1,F11,F21}|*|PARTNER=2| = 6 => Sweep D = 195. Totals: 1496 refusals (1475 shared_worker_block_unverified + 21 shared_worker_present) plus EXACTLY ONE authorised armed:true (the B27 positive control) across 1497 decide() invocations. Zero unexpected armed:true and zero unexpected shared_worker_present are gate conditions.

Section J becomes the CONF-04 gate. CONF-01, CONF-02 and CONF-03 stay PARTIAL records of what they executed and are NOT edited (evidence documents are referenced, never rewritten). CONF-04 requires the FULL matrix rerun on Node 22.19.0 and 24.21.0, every Node-side row, all sweeps and proxy cases, every browser row and the 21-realm gate, FC1, FC2, IC1, IC2, IC4 and IC8 executed independently, popups created by a real user gesture, >=3 repetitions per required row, identity and same-process checks, zero unexpected arms, zero uncaught throws, zero skipped required rows, zero non-loopback requests, FC1 unverified in EVERY repetition, the current Chromium refusing in EVERY full-gate repetition, fc2Pass true and explained, cleanup of CONF-04-owned processes/profiles/identity files/fixtures/listeners, and READ-ONLY identification (pid, owner process, command, relation) of the two pre-existing loopback listeners without terminating anything CONF-04 did not start. Worker WebSocket and F16..F21 stay labelled by measured/unmeasured status with their fail-closed decision paths tested.

Rev 29 weakens nothing: counts stay 98/89/6/3, C6-T stays 27/5, M-23 and M-24 stay closed, M-25 and M-26 stay OPEN, O-1 and the PILOT_APPROVAL_RUN_TOKEN text are untouched, OWNER-24 and OWNER-25 stay DECIDED, PROXY-27 stays withdrawn, the supported-browser set stays EMPTY, scope stays Chromium only, reason codes stay snake_case, no exit code is added, no public surface and no bypass exists.
